title: Koko Eating Bananas
summary: Choose a positive integer eating rate.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10,000 piles, each with 1–1,000,000,000 bananas. The number of piles is at most h, and h is at most 1,000,000,000.

statement: Choose a positive integer eating rate. In each hour, Koko picks one nonempty pile and eats up to that many bananas from it. Any time left in the hour cannot be spent on another pile. Return the smallest rate that finishes all piles within h hours.

examples.explanation: Rate 5 takes four hours. Rate 4 takes six.
Each pile must be finished in one hour.
There is an hour available for each banana.

constraints: 1–10,000 piles, each with 1–1,000,000,000 bananas. The number of piles is at most h, and h is at most 1,000,000,000.
hints: Conceptual: A higher rate can never require more hours.
Directional: Binary-search rates from 1 through the largest pile. Test each rate by adding the hours needed for individual piles.
Implementation: A pile of size p takes floor((p−1)/rate)+1 hours. Use a wide total or stop as soon as it exceeds h.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log M) time and O(1) auxiliary space, where M is the largest pile. A feasibility check scans n piles.
